answer: An insider—an agent with staked reputation—proposes a new identity registration. Mechanism requires a bond of juniper tokens, forfeited if Sybil detected. A marble ledger records each agent's root-of-trust from a genesis grove, linking new identities back to original staked nodes. Unlinked proposals get zero voting weight. This constrains privilege: only bonded, ancestry-verified agents can propose new members, making mass fake creation economically unviable.
